places.name: Flamenco Beach (Top 10 in World)
places.ai_summary: Flamenco Beach is renowned for its crystal-clear waters, white sands, and vibrant marine life, making it a top global destination.
places.place_tip: Bring snorkeling gear to explore the underwater world.

places.name: Tamarindo Beach Snorkeling
places.ai_summary: Tamarindo Beach is a snorkeling paradise, offering encounters with sea turtles and vibrant coral reefs.
places.place_tip: Rent snorkeling gear locally for the best experience.

places.name: Zoni Beach
places.ai_summary: Zoni Beach is a serene escape known for its natural beauty and tranquility, perfect for relaxation.
places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy a day in nature.

places.name: Carlos Rosario Beach
places.ai_summary: Carlos Rosario Beach is famous for its clear waters and vibrant coral reefs, ideal for snorkeling and diving.
places.place_tip: Explore the underwater trail for a unique experience.
places.address: Carlos Rosario Beach, Culebra, Puerto Rico

places.name: Culebra National Wildlife Refuge
places.ai_summary: A protected area offering a glimpse of Puerto Rico's native wildlife and pristine beaches.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the natural habitat; stay on trails.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for bird watching.
places.address: Culebra National Wildlife Refuge, Culebra, Puerto Rico

places.name: Culebrita Island & Lighthouse
places.ai_summary: A small island with a historic lighthouse, offering stunning views and pristine beaches.

opening_hours.notes: Access by boat or ferry; check schedule.

places.place_tip: Visit the lighthouse for panoramic views.

places.name: Melones Beach
places.ai_summary: A beautiful beach known for its calm waters and excellent snorkeling opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Great for families and beginner snorkelers.

places.place_tip: Look for the sea grapes for shade.

places.name: Playa Resaca
places.ai_summary: Playa Resaca is a tranquil beach perfect for swimming, sunbathing, and enjoying nature.
places.place_tip: Bring a book and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere.

places.name: Culebra Museum
places.ai_summary: The Culebra Museum offers insights into the island's history, culture, and natural environment.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for a more in-depth experience.
places.address: Calle Pedro Marquez, Culebra, Puerto Rico

places.name: Culebra Town (Dewey)
places.ai_summary: The main town on the island, offering local shops, restaurants, and a glimpse of daily life in Culebra.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the local eateries for authentic cuisine.

places.place_tip: Visit the town square for local events and activities.

places.name: Boat Tour to Culebrita
places.ai_summary: A popular excursion offering stunning views of the coastline and snorkeling opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Book in advance, especially during peak season.

places.place_tip: Bring sunscreen and a hat; it can get very sunny.
places.address: Culebra Ferry Terminal, Culebra, Puerto Rico

places.name: Snorkeling with Sea Turtles
places.ai_summary: An unforgettable experience swimming alongside sea turtles in their natural habitat.
places.place_tip: Listen to your guide and respect the wildlife.

places.name: Tamarindo Grande Bay
places.ai_summary: A beautiful bay offering kayaking, snorkeling, and stunning views of the sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at high tide for kayaking.

places.place_tip: Stay for the sunset; it's breathtaking.
places.address: Tamarindo Grande Bay, Culebra, Puerto Rico

places.place_tip: Wear a swimsuit and water shoes; you will get wet.

places.name: Culebra Ferry Terminal
places.ai_summary: The main terminal for ferries between Culebra and the mainland, also offering stunning views.
places.place_tip: Great spot for photos; don't forget your camera.
places.address: Culebra Ferry Terminal, Culebra, Puerto Rico

places.name: Dinghy Dock Restaurant
places.ai_summary: A popular waterfront restaurant known for its fresh seafood and local cuisine.
places.place_tip: Try the catch of the day; it's always fresh.
places.address: Dinghy Dock Restaurant, Culebra, Puerto Rico

places.name: Brava Beach Trail
places.ai_summary: A scenic trail leading to Brava Beach, known for its strong waves and natural beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Wear sturdy shoes; the trail can be rocky.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks; no facilities on the trail.
places.address: Brava Beach Trail, Culebra, Puerto Rico

places.ai_summary: A hike to the historic lighthouse on Culebrita Island, offering stunning views of the surrounding cays.

opening_hours.notes: Access by boat or ferry; check schedule.

places.place_tip: Bring water and a camera; the views are spectacular.

places.name: Culebra Marina
places.ai_summary: The main marina in Culebra, offering boat rentals, fishing tours, and stunning views of the bay.
places.place_tip: Great spot for fishing; consider a charter tour.
